summary: Build tourism product development skills with journey mapping, packaging, and launch planning. Learn practical tools and apply them in 5 days.
lede: Product development in travel and tourism turns visitor needs and destination assets into experiences that can be packaged, delivered, and evaluated. For professionals in tourism, destination development, hospitality, and community-based tourism, this course offers a practical process for assessing opportunities and preparing visitor offers for launch. You will practice segmenting visitors, mapping journeys and touchpoints, shaping value propositions, and checking stakeholder and operational readiness, with launch planning and performance measures.
audienceIntro: This course is intended for professionals who already work in tourism, destination development, hospitality, or community-based tourism and need a structured method for building products that visitors can understand, book, and value.
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop, a spreadsheet tool, and at least one tourism product idea, destination asset inventory, or visitor experience you want to develop during the course. Familiarity with tourism, hospitality, destination planning, or community tourism helps you move faster through the exercises and get more value from the templates and workshops.
